input: Where can I park on my first day, and how do I get out of the building if there's a fire?

facilities.reply:
Hi Chloe, Riverside House has 20 parking spaces, booked in the DeskBook app from Monday 30 November. Four accessible spaces next to the entrance are kept for staff with a blue badge or a medical need. Email facilities@example.com to reserve one permanently, ideally before your first day [FAC-01].

For fire evacuation, facilities will make a personal evacuation plan with you. Ask for one at facilities@example.com before Monday 7 December. Evacuation chairs are kept at every stairwell, and trained fire wardens help people who have a plan [FAC-04].

Our articles don't answer some of your questions. These include the step-free route to the entrance and Zone A, and evacuation lifts or refuge areas. They also omit warden arrangements on varying office days, your team's assembly point and manager duties. Please raise these in the same email so facilities can build them into your plan.
